from_notes_src: AP Reorganisation Act, 2014 (lddashboard.legislative.gov.in/sites/default/files/A2014-6.pdf) s.26; Constitution Art. 170(3); app notes 2:42 sub 6
x: Sec. 26 is 'subject to Art. 170', and Art. 170(3) freezes seat numbers until the first Census after 2026, so the increase can be effected before then only by amending Art. 170. A Central notification or Assembly resolutions cannot do it; 'no delimitation till 2026' ignores the amendment route.
